verdict.rationale: Foreloop's workflow lets a PM describe a need in plain language ("Users can't tell which invoices are overdue"), turn it into an intention/task, and have a coding agent claim it, implement it, and open a PR with automated review, requiring only a person's approval to proceed (foreloop-docs-3,4,7,35,37). However, the evidence pack never mentions ingesting a mockup or design artifact (e.g., Figma file) as the trigger, and some documented flows still assume 'copy the intention into your coding agent or normal development process' (foreloop-docs-31), suggesting engineering involvement can still occur. Missing for 10: explicit design/mockup ingestion support, and clearer evidence that the full loop (approval → PR → merge) can run without any engineer touching the process.
